Hi Americans!

You're a happy bunch of armed people that have often gotten really defensive about gun control. I understand - but really the US has a problem with it's gun culture and the odd mass shooting. It's a thing. I know.

I'm just presenting a different view, and who actually came up with that view. Just saying.

Us Americans don't trust our government. It's a corrupt organization bought out by massive corporations. Mass shootings are primarily carried out within "gun free zones" because they're easy targets. Gun control would only treat a symptom of what's causing mass shootings, not the cure for the overall public illness that drives people to commit them. Criminals will still find ways to obtain guns to serve their purposes because they're criminals and don't care about the law in the first place.

The British gave us our independence, we voted for our constitution. We arrived at our constitution even more democratically than the Americans.
